zebra--noun.def: An African animal like a horse with black and white stripes.
zebra--noun.ex: A zebra grazed near the road.

analyst--noun.def: A person whose job is studying information carefully.
analyst--noun.ex: The analyst expects a slow year.

assess--verb.def: To judge the quality or the amount of something.

duplicate--noun.ex: Keep a duplicate of the key.

chaotic--adj.def: In a state of complete disorder.

overly--adv.def: Too much, more than is good.

picky--adj.def: Hard to please and choosing very carefully.

manufacturing--noun.def: The making of goods in factories.
manufacturing--noun.exTr: İmalat burada binlerce kişiyi istihdam ediyor.

proudly--adv.def: In a way that shows you are pleased with something.

interpreter--noun.def: A person who translates speech as it happens.

tyranny--noun.def: Cruel and unfair use of power.

rosy--adj.def: Pink in colour, or hopeful and promising.

nomination--noun.def: The act of suggesting someone for a job or a prize.

accordingly--adv.def: In a way that suits the situation, or therefore.
accordingly--adv.ex: Plans changed, so we acted accordingly.
accordingly--adv.exTr: Planlar değişti, biz de buna göre davrandık.

import--verb.def: To bring goods into a country to sell.

anticipate--verb.def: To expect something and prepare for it.

dictator--noun.def: A ruler with complete power who is not elected.

observer--noun.def: A person who watches an event without taking part.

output--noun.def: The amount a person or a machine produces.

obedient--adj.def: Doing what you are told to do.

comfortably--adv.def: In a way that feels relaxed and easy.

beak--noun.def: The hard pointed mouth of a bird.
beak--noun.ex: The bird carried straw in its beak.

intrude--verb.def: To enter a place or a situation where you are not wanted.
intrude--verb.ex: I hope I am not intruding.

adjustment--noun.def: A small change made to improve something.

microscope--noun.def: An instrument that makes very small things look larger.
microscope--noun.ex: Look at the cell under a microscope.

correspondence--noun.def: Letters and emails exchanged between people.

presidency--noun.def: The position of president, or the time in it.

devote--verb.def: To give your time or effort completely to something.
devote--verb.ex: She devoted her life to teaching.

aluminum--noun.def: A light silver metal that does not rust.
aluminum--noun.ex: The frame is made of aluminum.

commonwealth--noun.def: A group of countries linked by history and interests.
commonwealth--noun.ex: The commonwealth holds its own games.

inventor--noun.def: A person who creates something new.

adequate--adj.def: Enough in amount or good enough in quality.

highlight--noun.def: The best or most interesting part of something.

imperative--noun.def: The verb form used for orders, or something that must be done.

trader--noun.def: A person who buys and sells goods.

segment--noun.def: One part of something that is divided.
segment--noun.ex: Eat one segment of the orange.

overlook--verb.def: To fail to notice something, or to have a view over it.

icon--noun.def: A small picture on a screen, or a famous admired person.
icon--noun.ex: Click the icon to open it.

immigrant--noun.def: A person who comes to live permanently in another country.

hygiene--noun.def: The practice of keeping clean to stay healthy.

dramatically--adv.def: By a very large and noticeable amount.

truthful--adj.def: Telling the truth and not lying.

investor--noun.def: A person or company that puts money into a business.
investor--noun.ex: A foreign investor bought the land.

component--noun.def: One of the parts that make up a whole.

rhythmic--adj.def: Having a regular repeated pattern of sound or movement.
rhythmic--adj.ex: The waves made a rhythmic sound.

feat--noun.def: An impressive act showing skill or strength.
feat--noun.ex: Crossing alone was a real feat.
feat--noun.exTr: Tek başına geçmek gerçek bir başarıydı.

outlet--noun.def: A shop selling one company's goods, or a way out.

functional--adj.def: Working properly, or designed to be useful.
functional--adj.ex: The kitchen is small but functional.

refrain--noun.def: The part of a song repeated after each verse.

obedience--noun.def: The act of doing what you are told.

intrusion--noun.def: The act of entering where you are not wanted.

indifferent--adj.ex: He seemed indifferent to the result.

grin--noun.def: A wide smile showing the teeth.

postal--adj.def: Relating to the sending of letters.

muse--verb.def: To think about something quietly for a long time.
muse--verb.ex: He mused on the old days.

prestige--noun.def: The respect a person or a place has earned.

helper--noun.def: A person who helps someone else with work.

nobility--noun.def: The people of highest social rank, or moral greatness.

decoration--noun.def: Something added to make a place look attractive.

coalition--noun.def: A government or group formed by several parties together.

kangaroo--noun.def: An Australian animal that jumps on strong back legs.

rite--noun.def: A traditional ceremony, often a religious one.

unreliable--adj.def: Not able to be trusted to work or to be true.

scramble--verb.def: To climb quickly using your hands, or to mix eggs.

starvation--noun.def: Suffering or death caused by having no food.

explorer--noun.def: A person who travels to discover unknown places.

lark--noun.def: A small brown bird known for singing as it flies.
lark--noun.ex: A lark sang above the field.
lark--noun.exTr: Tarlanın üstünde bir tarla kuşu öttü.

incense--noun.def: A substance burnt to give a sweet smell.

folly--noun.ex: It was folly to sail that night.

prehistoric--adj.def: From the time before written records.

enhance--verb.def: To improve the quality or value of something.

diplomat--noun.def: An official who represents a country abroad.

peer--noun.def: A person of the same age or rank as you.

disconnect--verb.def: To separate something from a power or a network.

morally--adv.def: In a way relating to right and wrong.

strive--verb.def: To try very hard to achieve something.

perceive--verb.def: To notice or to understand something in a certain way.
perceive--verb.ex: Dogs perceive sounds we cannot hear.
